verdict.rationale: Termius ships one AI feature: it turns a plain-language description into a shell command (termius-docs-6). That is an AI-generated suggestion, but it is not an insight drawn from the user's own data. Autocomplete does use the user's shell history and snippets (termius-docs-24), but nothing says it is AI-driven, and session logs (termius-docs-7) are searchable only, with no AI analysis. Missing for 10: AI insights or analysis over user data such as session logs, hosts or history; AI-driven suggestions grounded in user data; in-depth docs on the AI feature; independent or hands-on corroboration.
